correctness.rationale: Exactly 2^19 finite labelled configurations are exhausted in a mask-popcount functional-graph classification and a separately implemented C++ direct-bit iterate test. Both produce two fixed states, ten 19-cycles, exact four-update entry cutoff, full basin and first-entry tables; all 190 arc-phase transitions F(R_s a_k)=R_(s+5)a_k are checked. The global identity F^23=F^4 and the 3306 explicit failures of F^22=F^3 prove sharpness. The claim is finite only, and prior Paley counts were reproduced separately.

value.rationale: C19 is the canonical regular consecutive-offset tournament, giving a natural matched comparison at nineteen vertices and out-degree nine with the Paley tournament. The complete ten travelling-wave classification, each exact basin, and the sharp first-entry distribution quantify a substantial mathematical contrast: zero versus 342 primitive four-cycles and 275806 versus 516764 consensus-attracted states. This cannot be inferred from order, regularity, or existing qualitative restrictions; the exact finite invariant is a reusable reference benchmark.
